text:
tian: Heads-up — proposing we lift the runtime pin for runtime-v3.2 in eu-west tonight (00:30 UTC) to finish the canary. I want to surface any SDK/quant compatibility flags before we do.

deploybot: @channel Automated pinlist check: runtime-v3.2 currently pinned for models: llama3q, gptx2-quant. Pin reason: 'compat-safety-eu'. Can schedule unpin window: 00:30-02:30 UTC. Reply `yes` to confirm.

alex: quick note — SDK 2.8 has a new kv cache layout that requires runtime >=3.2. If we unpin runtime before SDK rollout we might get mixed behavior for existing sdk clients. Not a blocker but needs a plan.

mike: +1. Also saw a small embedding drift in preflight when runtime was bumped locally with quant-v4b. Need to run the smoke set (embed-regression-2026) before flipping traffic.

jess: Proposed plan: 1) run smoke suite against a staging canary (quant+kv) — 20m 2) if green, unpin eu-west canary only and shift 5% traffic for 30m 3) run evals, then 25/50/100. rollback if any >3% delta on quality metrics.

sara: I can run the embed-regression-2026 set now and attach results. Also, who owns the release notes blurb for this change? We should call out: 'SDK 2.8 consumer note: kv-cache handshake requires runtime 3.2+ — fallbacks possible but degraded perf.'

tian: thanks @sara — please post results in this thread. We should also add an operator-friendly rollback command in the runbook. e.g.:

```
# roll back runtime pin (quick fallback)
deploybot pin runtime-v3.2 --add --reason "rollback-quick" --scope eu-west
# route 100% to runtime-v3.1
router set-route --service inference --runtime runtime-v3.1 --weight 1.0
```

alex: small nit — make sure `router set-route` is idempotent for partial weights, otherwise nightshift might misfire.

mike: smoke run finished locally — embedding median delta = +0.4%, p95 latency +6ms. Looks fine so far but p99 increased on a tiny sample. I'll run a larger sample in staging.

sara: embed-regression-2026 results posted: PASS (n=5k), median delta +0.5%, p99 regression 0.9% (within threshold). Uploading logs to /tmp/embed-checks/8880001234.log

jess: ok — can we do a small cross-region sanity? Maybe 2% eu-west + 1% us-west for 15m to catch any region-specific jitters before full unpin?

tian: good idea. @deploybot please schedule: unpin runtime-v3.2 in eu-west canary at 00:30, then route 2% eu-west + 1% us-west. Hold if any errors >5xx or if quality delta >3% (auto-rollback).

deploybot: Scheduled: unpin runtime-v3.2 (eu-west) at 00:30 UTC. Canary traffic plan: eu-west 2% @00:35, us-west 1% @00:50. Auto-rollback hooks set: 5xx >2% or quality delta >3%. Operator contact: @tian, @mike.

alex: I'll draft the release-note snippet and PR it — will call out: SDK 2.8 interop notes + how to pin back.

sara: one more ask — can we gate by quant profile? If quant-v4b is heavy we should keep it pinned until we validate.

jess: yes — add rule: if request.quant_profile == "v4b" then route to runtime-v3.1 until we confirm. small ACL in router should handle it.

tian: agreed. Adding that rule now to canary config. We'll reconvene at 00:15 UTC to confirm final go/no-go. Thanks all :thumbsup:
